alt: A room corner with a wooden shelf beneath a window, holding potted houseplants and glass propagation jars, woven storage baskets below, folded textile cloth, lit by warm sidelight
text:
months before the first bloom, this corner was built for it.

the shelf the light the glass jars—not decoration. preparation.

a room designed for patient growth receives its flowers on schedule.
